decision: Permit Toggle.icon as required icon-only content with a required accessible label; the labelled-text branch and all other components remain unchanged.

evidence.channel: Explicit interactive owner selection forwarded by the parent task
evidence.interpretation: Assistant-recorded explicit interactive owner selection, not native, signed, independent or per-payload serialized approval. Hashes bind recorded content, not proof of consent. Neither Button nor IconButton approval is authority for this receipt.

limits: Toggle only: icon is required in the icon-only branch alongside a required accessible label. The labelled-text branch is unchanged.
No other component gains icon-only permission. Trailing and interactive icons remain excluded.
The exceptions array represents alternative names, not this same-name semantic amendment.
Historical receipt bytes and hashes remain immutable. Contract approval and the parent-approved implementation plan are separate from this naming decision.

before.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology.
before.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text.
before.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning.

after.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology. Toggle alone also accepts a required decorative icon as its sole visible content, with a required accessible label.
after.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text. Toggle alone permits its icon-only branch when icon and accessible label are both required.
after.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning. The icon-only exclusion has one exception: Toggle with a required icon and accessible label; no other component gains icon-only permission. Trailing and interactive icons remain excluded.

semanticAmendments.boundary: Toggle only; required icon and accessible label in its icon-only branch. No permission for Button, IconButton or other components is granted here; no change to Toggle's labelled-text branch, aliases, alternative-name exceptions or status.
